title: Dharma
description: The principle of cosmic order and duty in Indian religions.
body:
# Dharma

Dharma is a key concept in several Indian religions. It has multiple meanings depending on context.

## Meaning

Dharma can refer to law, duty, righteousness, or the inherent nature of something.

## In Buddhism

Buddhists often use the term to mean the teachings of the Buddha.

For more, see [Karma](/wiki/karma).
